h: Sunday Igboho: "We will disrupt everywhere" if a governor tries to remove the Olubadan
p: Yoruba activist Sunday Igboho has reportedly warned that any governor who plans to remove the Olubadan will face disruption "everywhere". The warning has stirred reactions over the status of the Ibadan throne.
more: Supporters of the monarch have welcomed the stand.
The state government has not replied publicly yet.
